patthana21.51:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca no saññojano sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi pañhā,
patthana21.51:2.1: no ganthaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no gantho sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana21.51:4.1: no oghaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no ogho sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana21.51:6.1: no yogaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no yogo sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana21.51:8.1: no nīvaraṇaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no nīvaraṇo sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.51:10.1: no parāmāsaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no parāmāso sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana21.51:11.1: hetuyā tīṇi. na sārammaṇaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ
